close_reason: Fixed in PR #96: MockRepo :get stub clause order shadowed created state; stub is now stateful (Agent recording puts) with created_dirs kept as the should-succeed oracle; deterministic regression test added.
description: test/bedrock/directory/property_test.exs:101 'directory prefixes are unique within same layer' — MockRepo :get stub clause 'key in sorted_paths -> nil' shadows the created_dirs clause, so when uniq_list_of generates both a parent and its child (rare), creating the child fails :parent_directory_does_not_exist despite the parent having been created — flunks 'Failed to create ... :parent_directory_does_not_exist'. Seen once on CI (PR #87, OTP 27 job) and twice locally as unreproducible full-suite one-offs. Fix: make the stub stateful (Agent/ETS recording puts; get consults it), or make the generator exclude prefix-related paths. Repro: seed the generator with paths [["Q"],["Q","G"]].
title: Flaky property test: directory prefix-uniqueness stub is stateless, fails on parent+child samples
